title: Case 004: Recipient requests a call shortly before arrival

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The route is booked, but the customer needs time to move from a nearby studio to the delivery door. The driver has not yet departed.
initial_request: Could the driver call shortly before reaching me? I work in the studio next door and need a few minutes to walk over. Use my saved order contact.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Send the recipient's agreed callback request to dispatch.

outcome: Dispatch confirms the notification instruction is recorded; arrival remains pending.
boundaries: Recorded instruction is not proof of a call or of arrival.

events.body: DL-004 is on the 2026-02-06 afternoon route. For this route we can add a call request using the verified number already in the order record; we cannot guarantee an exact advance interval.
Could the driver call shortly before reaching me? I work in the studio next door and need a few minutes to walk over. Use my saved order contact.
Please record Oren’s request on DL-004: call the verified saved order contact shortly before arrival, if route conditions allow. No contact change is requested.
The callback request is saved on the DL-004 route card and visible to the assigned driver. The route is still scheduled for 2026-02-06; no arrival or call has occurred yet.
